verdict.rationale: Martin is itself an AI personal assistant. Its docs show users delegating many kinds of tasks to it: calendar events, email drafting, replies and triage, Slack messages, reminders, to-dos, notes, multi-step shortcuts and proactive background tasks, all reachable from phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email and Slack. Hands-on users confirm it handles complicated requests correctly and manages their to-dos across devices. Missing for 10: the docs are brief one-line summaries with no depth on task limits or how failures are handled, and the team itself acknowledges past reliability problems with actions it takes on users' behalf.
